findings: BOOT OK at start: node tools/harness/smoke.mjs passes (6/6).

ARC ROOT CAUSE FOUND (ablation, /tmp scratch ablate.mjs): the measured arc is produced almost entirely by swing.js's `clavicle_r.rz` track, NOT by arc_deg. TSW r1.1 declares 6.5 deg and the rig sweeps 69.6; deleting clavicle_r.rz alone takes it to 9.5 (PASS). Deleting the ENTIRE yaw chain (the arc itself) only takes 69.6 -> 65.4. clavicle_r.rz swings a FIXED 32+8e degrees across the active window for every clip regardless of declared arc.
Fast arc harness reproduces the critic's kritik-arc.mjs exactly: 24/28 arc nonconforming, 21/28 recovery>active, WHP r1.1 pose step 1.026 m. Safe to iterate against.

IMPACT MODEL WIRED. New game/src/combat/impact.js is the single arithmetic; resolve.js calls it at hit time; MovesetLibrary's five accessors delegate to it so harness and fight cannot disagree. moves.js no longer collapses the 5x7 grid to .flesh at build time.

All 22 enemy statblocks now declare `material`; 3 declare `material_by_region` (slitherfang chitin/flesh head, hist-marked champion plant/metal/flesh, legion metal/flesh head). 8 new mat_* dummies drive wpn-material-range.

DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED (data): RI-WPN05 A's victim table mixes DELTA rows (flesh/wood +4, chitin +2) with ABSOLUTE-ZERO rows (water, stone/metal/shield). classes.json encoded both as victim_delta 0, so stone gave victim = attacker + 0 = 16 where the item says 0. Added `victim_hitstop_mode`.

DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED (engine): hitstop held N-1 frames, not N. `hitstopUntil = frame + N` with a `> frame` test holds F+1..F+N-1. Round 2's 'hitstop_f 4 held for 3 frames' was a real 1-frame shortfall against RI-WPN05 M1's +/-0 tolerance, not a reporting artefact. Now frame + N + 1.

Per-body hitstop added (system.js): each body holds on b.hitstopUntil. When every body is held the step takes the identical early return wave 1 took. This is what makes RI-WPN05 A's asymmetry observable at all.

MEASURED: tools/weapons/impact-consumption.mjs 17/17 CONSUMED. tools/weapons/impact-census.mjs M1 0 failures (5x7 attacker AND victim grids exact), M2 0 failures (18 cells, 0/22 statblocks missing material, 1 distinct damage over 20 repeats), M3 deflection PASS (TSW+SSW deflect, MCE bypasses, +16f exact), M4 0 failures, ILS_unique 0.8286 (bar 0.80), tier span ok, monotone true.
CONFIRMED BAR DEFECT: ILS_1nn (RI-WPN05 F's literal leave-one-out nearest-neighbour over 35 unique points) = 0.0000 by construction, exactly as the round-2 critic filed. Reporting both readings.

The round-2 critic's kritik-consumption3.mjs can only reach 2/6 on ANY correct build: four of its six probes perturb rows a FLESH dummy never reads, and it observes only {dmg, hitF, attacker hitstop} so it cannot see a knockback. Reproduced and documented rather than claimed passing.
